req.title: Player payload includes position
req.statement: The system shall include the position field on every player response.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-034 requires that every player response includes the 'position' field. Tests must verify: (1) a normal GET /players/{id} returns HTTP 200 with a non-empty 'position' field (positive/EP), (2) a GET with an invalid UUID returns HTTP 422 and no player body (negative/NEG), (3) a GET for a non-existent valid UUID returns HTTP 404 (negative/NEG), (4) the position field value exactly matches the seeded data for a known player (EP + mutation-resilience), (5) boundary: the first and last seeded players both carry 'position' (BVA), (6) a player whose position is a multi-word string still surfaces correctly (EP). All tests use FastAPI TestClient in-process, assert exact status codes and exact field values to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_position_present_and_exact_for_known_player
preconditions: Player with id=97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802 exists with position='Defensive Midfield'
trace: R-PLAYER-034: position field must be present on every player response
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_position_present_and_exact_for_known_player():
    r = client.get('/players/97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert 'position' in body
    assert body['position'] == 'Defensive Midfield'
    assert body['id'] == '97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802'
